computerCustomLogo.enable.name: Enable custom logo on the computer property dialog
computerCustomLogo.enable.name[zh_CN]: 启用计算机属性对话框自定义图标
computerCustomLogo.enable.description[zh_CN]: 用于控制计算机属性对话框中是否显示自定义图标
computerCustomLogo.enable.description: It's used to control whether to display the custom logo in the computer property dialog

computerCustomLogo.resourcePath.name: Custom logo resource path
computerCustomLogo.resourcePath.description[zh_CN]: 自定义图标图片的本地文件路径，为空时不显示
computerCustomLogo.resourcePath.description: The local file path of the custom logo image. It is not displayed when empty

computerCustomLogo.verticalOffset.name: Custom logo vertical offset
computerCustomLogo.verticalOffset.description[zh_CN]: 自定义图标的垂直偏移量（逻辑像素）。不与系统 logo 重叠：大于等于 0 在其下方（间距即偏移量），小于 0 在其上方（绝对值为间距）
computerCustomLogo.verticalOffset.description: The vertical offset of the custom logo (in logical pixels). It does not overlap the system logo: >=0 places it below (offset is the gap), <0 places it above (absolute value is the gap)

computerCustomLogo.horizontalOffset.name: Custom logo horizontal offset
computerCustomLogo.horizontalOffset.description[zh_CN]: 自定义图标的水平偏移量（逻辑像素），0 与系统 logo 水平居中，大于 0 向右，小于 0 向左
computerCustomLogo.horizontalOffset.description: The horizontal offset of the custom logo (in logical pixels). 0 centers it horizontally on the system logo, greater than 0 moves right, less than 0 moves left

computerCustomLogo.width.name: Custom logo width
computerCustomLogo.width.description[zh_CN]: 自定义图标的最大宽度（逻辑像素），作为等比缩放约束框
computerCustomLogo.width.description: The maximum width of the custom logo (in logical pixels), used as the proportional scaling bounding box

computerCustomLogo.height.name: Custom logo height
computerCustomLogo.height.description[zh_CN]: 自定义图标的最大高度（逻辑像素），作为等比缩放约束框
computerCustomLogo.height.description: The maximum height of the custom logo (in logical pixels), used as the proportional scaling bounding box
